Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a chemical proteomics/ABPP approach involving a click reaction (CuAAC) and avidin-agarose enrichment to identify targets of usnic acid. While 'acetylation' is listed as a variable modification in MaxQuant, it is specified as N-term, which is standard for protein search and does not indicate an acetylome enrichment workflow.

scope: For enrichment, the protein solutions were added to 50 μL of pre washed avidin-agarose bead suspension (1.1 mg/mL, washed thrice with PBS +0.4% SDS) and incubated at room temperature for one hour with constant mild agitation.

To remove unbound proteins, beads were washed thrice with PBS +0.4% SDS, thrice with 6 M urea (dd H2O) and thrice with PBS before resuspension in 200 μL capping buffer (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea in 20 mM HEPES).

For on-bead enzymatic digestion of the proteins, 600 μL TEAB (50 mM in dd H2O) was added followed by 1.5 μL trypsin solution (0.05 μg/μL in 50 mM acetic acid) and incubation for 16 hours (37 °C, 600 rpm).
